frame_units.tracker_fps: sum of max_frame values in the physical tracker output manifest / tracker wall seconds
frame_units.video_frame_fps: unique video frames / referring inference seconds
frame_units.complete_pipeline_fps: unique video frames / (tracker wall seconds + referring inference seconds)

instrumentation.flexhook: evaluation manifest records inference time, model-loading time, peak memory, and both frame-rate units
instrumentation.flexhook_temporal: learned temporal-head evaluation records the same timing and frame-rate fields while keeping the frozen tracker and task checkpoint
instrumentation.yestrack: overall_infer_time.json records inference/model-loading time and peak memory; adapter copies the record into YESTRACK_EVAL_MANIFEST.json
instrumentation.common_tracker: future tracker runs record wall time, frame count, and tracker FPS in TRACKER_RUN_MANIFEST.json
instrumentation.pipeline_report: scripts/measure_efficiency.py joins a tracker manifest with a referring-evaluation manifest

current_evidence_boundary.existing_flexhook_f1_formal: legacy manifest predates this instrumentation; no efficiency number is claimed
current_evidence_boundary.existing_common_tracker_outputs: legacy manifests have incomplete timing metadata; no tracker or pipeline FPS is claimed
current_evidence_boundary.strict_runs: instrumentation is ready before their post-training evaluation watchers launch

validation.compile_check: all modified Python files compile in the project environment
